records.jp: うーん……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: 梨佳？　どうかしたの？
records.en_original: Rika? What's wrong?
records.en_auxiliary: Rika? What's wrong?
records.en: Rika? What's wrong?

records.jp: あ、日菜子ちゃん
records.en_original: Oh, Hinako.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, Hinako.
records.en: Oh, Hinako-chan.

records.jp: ……ねえ、日菜子ちゃんから見て、<CR>私ってどう見える？
records.en_original: ...Hey, from your point of view, how do I seem to you?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Hey, from your point of view, how do I seem to you?
records.en: ...Hey, Hinako-chan, how do I look to you?

records.jp: え？　ええと……普通じゃない？<CR>いつもの梨佳だと思うけど
records.en_original: Huh? Um... Normal? You're the same Rika as always.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Um... Normal? You're the same Rika as always.
records.en: Huh? Um... Normal? You're the same Rika as always.

records.jp: はあぁ……
records.en_original: *sigh*...
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh*
records.en: *sigh*...

records.jp: り、梨佳？
records.en_original: R-Rika?
records.en_auxiliary: R-Rika?
records.en: R-Rika?

records.jp: あ、ごめんね……。日菜子ちゃんは悪くないの。<CR>でもやっぱり私って“普通”なんだなあって……
records.en_original: Oh, sorry... It's not your fault or anything. I guess I really am "normal"...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, sorry. It's not your fault or anything. I guess I really am "normal."
records.en: Oh, sorry... It's not your fault, Hinako-chan.<CR>But I guess I really am "normal"...

records.jp: あ……えっと、言葉が悪かったかな……。<CR>普段通りの梨佳って意味での普通だよ
records.en_original: Oh... Um, maybe I used the wrong word... I just meant you're no different from how you usually are.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh... Um, maybe I used the wrong word. I just meant you're no different from how you usually are.
records.en: Oh... Um, maybe I used the wrong word... I just meant you're no different from how you usually are.

records.jp: ううん、いいの……自覚はあるし、<CR>何とかしたいって思ってるから……
records.en_original: No, it's fine... I know I'm normal, but I want to do something about it...
records.en_auxiliary: No, it's fine. I know I'm normal, but I want to do something about it.
records.en: No, it's fine... I know I'm normal, but I want to do something about it...

records.jp: 成績も普通くらいの順位、好きなものもごく普通、<CR>カラオケに行っても普通の点数……何をしても普通ばっかり
records.en_original: My grades are about average, I like average things, my karaoke score is average... Everything I do is normal.
records.en_auxiliary: My grades are about average. I like average things. My karaoke score is average. Everything I do is normal.
records.en: My grades are about average, I like average things, my karaoke score is average... Everything I do is normal.

records.jp: 普通って、そんなに悪いことじゃないと思うけど……
records.en_original: I don't think being normal is a bad thing...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think being normal is a bad thing.
records.en: I don't think being normal is a bad thing...

records.jp: そんなことないよ！<CR>私にとっては一生戦っていかなきゃいけない宿敵だよ！
records.en_original: That's not true! To me, it's my arch enemy. I've been trying to fight it my entire life!
records.en_auxiliary: That's not true! To me, it's my arch enemy. I've been trying to fight it my entire life!
records.en: That's not true! To me, it's my arch enemy. I've been trying to fight it my entire life!

records.jp: そ、そこまで言う……！？
records.en_original: I-It's that big a deal!?
records.en_auxiliary: I-it's that big a deal?!
records.en: I-It's that big a deal!?

records.jp: ……はっ。と、とにかく私、“普通”でいるのを<CR>何とかしたいんだ
records.en_original: *sigh*... A-Anyway, I want to do something about being so normal.
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh* A-anyway, I want to do something about being so normal.
records.en: *sigh*... A-Anyway, I want to do something about being so normal.

records.jp: でも、いつもと違うことをしてみても結局普通の結果しか<CR>出なくて、続かないんだよね……
records.en_original: But when I try to change my ways, the results end up normal, and I eventually fall back into what I usually do.
records.en_auxiliary: But when I try to change my ways, the results end up normal, and I eventually fall back into what I usually do.
records.en: But when I try to change my ways, the results end up normal, and I eventually fall back into what I usually do.

records.jp: 好きなことを続けるのが一番じゃない？<CR>継続は力なりって言うし
records.en_original: Isn't it best to just do the things you like? They say persistence makes you stronger.
records.en_auxiliary: Isn't it best to just do the things you like? They say persistence makes you stronger.
records.en: Isn't it best to just do the things you like? They say persistence makes you stronger.

records.jp: 最初は普通の結果しか出ないかもしれないけど……<CR>続けているうちにすごい結果が出せるかもしれないよ
records.en_original: Your results might just be normal at first, but if you keep going, you might get amazing results one day.
records.en_auxiliary: Your results might just be normal at first, but if you keep going, you might get amazing results one day.
records.en: Your results might just be normal at first, but if you keep going, you might get amazing results one day.

records.jp: あー、そっか……<CR>確かに、続けてみないとわからないよね……
records.en_original: Huh, I guess you're right... I'll never know if I don't try.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, I guess you're right. I'll never know if I don't try.
records.en: Huh, I guess you're right... I'll never know if I don't try.

records.jp: 今活躍してる人たちだって最初からすごい人たちだった<CR>わけじゃないってよく言うし！
records.en_original: They say that great people weren't just born that way, after all!
records.en_auxiliary: They say that great people weren't just born that way!
records.en: They say that great people weren't just born that way, after all!

records.jp: うんうん、梨佳の好きなことは何？
records.en_original: Exactly! So, what's your favorite thing to do?
records.en_auxiliary: Exactly! So, what's your favorite thing to do?
records.en: Exactly! So, what's your favorite thing to do?

records.jp: やっぱり走ることかな！
records.en_original: I'd say it's running!
records.en_auxiliary: I'd say it's running!
records.en: I'd say it's running!

records.jp: なるほど、陸上部だしね
records.en_original: Well, I suppose you are on the track team.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I suppose you are on the track team.
records.en: Well, I suppose you are on the track team.

records.jp: 好きなことをやってるうちに“普通”じゃなくなるなら、<CR>まさに一石二鳥だね！
records.en_original: I could stop being normal, while doing what I like! Two birds with one stone!
records.en_auxiliary: I could stop being normal, while doing what I like! Two birds with one stone!
records.en: I could stop being normal, while doing what I like! Two birds with one stone!

records.jp: ありがとう、日菜子ちゃん。<CR>よーし、頑張るぞー！
records.en_original: Thanks, Hinako. Alright, I'm gonna be the best I can be!
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks, Hinako. All right, I'm gonna be the best I can be!
records.en: Thanks, Hinako-chan. Alright, I'm gonna be the best I can be!

records.jp: 家に帰ってぐっすり寝る……のはどう？
records.en_original: What about... Going home and sleeping on it?
records.en_auxiliary: What about... Going home and sleeping on it?
records.en: What about... Going home and sleeping on it?

records.jp: え、寝ちゃうの？<CR>それだと普通に朝が来ちゃうよ
records.en_original: Huh, sleep? I'll tell you how that would end: normally. The sun would come up the same way it always does.
records.en_auxiliary: Sleep? I'll tell you how that would end: normally. The sun would come up the same way it always does.
records.en: Huh, sleep? I'll tell you how that would end: normally. The sun would come up the same way it always does.

records.jp: ほら、夢の中だったら、いつもとは違う梨佳になれるかも<CR>しれないじゃない？
records.en_original: You know, you might get to be a different you in a dream, right?
records.en_auxiliary: You know, you might get to be a different you in a dream, right?
records.en: You know, you might get to be a different you in a dream, right?

records.jp: あー、なるほど。すごい私になるなら夢の中。<CR>夢ならどんな私にでもなれる――
records.en_original: Ah, that's true. I could be amazing in my dreams. In a dream, I could be anyth--
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, that's true. I could be amazing in my dreams. In a dream, I could be anyth—
records.en: Ah, that's true. I could be amazing in my dreams. In a dream, I could be anyth--

records.jp: って、それじゃダメー！！
records.en_original: Wait, that won't help!
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, that won't help!
records.en: Wait, that won't help!

records.jp: あはは、やっぱり……？
records.en_original: Ahaha. I figured it wouldn't...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha. I figured it wouldn't.
records.en: Ahaha. I figured it wouldn't...

records.jp: 全くもう、日菜子ちゃんったら。<CR>真剣に悩んでるのにー……
records.en_original: Sheesh, Hinako. I'm seriously concerned here...
records.en_auxiliary: Sheesh, Hinako. I'm seriously concerned here.
records.en: Sheesh, Hinako-chan. I'm seriously concerned here...

records.jp: ごめん、ごめん。<CR>ちょっと悩みすぎてるように見えたからつい
records.en_original: Sorry, sorry. But you looked so worried, I couldn't help but try to make you laugh.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry, sorry. But you looked so worried, I couldn't help but try to make you laugh.
records.en: Sorry, sorry. But you looked so worried, I couldn't help but try to make you laugh.

records.jp: うー……でも、普通じゃない発想をするのって大事だし、<CR>意外と的外れでもないのかなあ……
records.en_original: Nnn... I guess it is important to imagine things that aren't normal, so maybe you are on to something...
records.en_auxiliary: Nnn... I guess it is important to imagine things that aren't normal, so maybe you are on to something.
records.en: Nnn... I guess it is important to imagine things that aren't normal, so maybe you are on to something...

records.jp: ひょっとしたら、夢のお告げとかあるかもしれないし、<CR>日菜子ちゃんみたいな魔法少女になれるかもしれないし！
records.en_original: Maybe I'll get some sort of divine message in a dream and turn into a magical girl like you!
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe I'll get some sort of divine message in a dream and turn into a magical girl like you!
records.en: Maybe I'll receive a divine message in a dream,<CR>or become a magical girl like you, Hinako-chan!

records.jp: え、ええと……<CR>ないこともない……のかな？
records.en_original: Umm... I guess it's not totally impossible...?
records.en_auxiliary: Umm... I guess it's not totally impossible?
records.en: Umm... I guess it's not totally impossible...?

records.jp: 毎日ちゃんと寝てるからそれはそれでいいとして……<CR>うん、起きてる時に出来ることも考えてみようかな
records.en_original: Anyway, I get plenty of sleep every day, so that's not a concern... I'll think of things to do while I'm awake.
records.en_auxiliary: Anyway, I get plenty of sleep every day, so that's not a concern. I'll think of things to do while I'm awake.
records.en: Anyway, I get plenty of sleep every day, so that's not a concern... I'll think of things to do while I'm awake.

records.jp: そ、そうだね……言っておいてなんだけど、<CR>あんまり現実的な方法とは言えないし
records.en_original: R-Right... I know I'm the one who said recommended sleep, but it wasn't a very realistic idea.
records.en_auxiliary: R-right. I know I'm the one who recommended sleep, but it probably wasn't the best course of action.
records.en: R-Right... I know I'm the one who said recommended sleep, but it wasn't a very realistic idea.

records.jp: とにかく聞いてくれてありがとう、日菜子ちゃん。<CR>私、頑張ってみるよ！
records.en_original: Thanks for listening, Hinako. I'll try my best!
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks for listening, Hinako. I'll try my best!
records.en: Thanks for listening, Hinako-chan. I'll try my best!

records.jp: それなら――
records.en_original: Then how about...
records.en_auxiliary: Then how about...
records.en: Then how about...
